title: 9 Costs of Leading Like Christ That Nobody Warns a Godly Man About
caption:
Nobody warns you about the actual cost before you say yes to leading anyone.

John 13: Jesus knew the Father had given all things into His hands. Then He picked up a towel and washed feet that would walk away from Him within the week. That's the model. Not authority. A towel.

Leading like Christ costs you the friend who just wanted a yes-man. It costs you credit for decisions nobody gets to see. It costs you the easy room.

The Garden came before the crown. It always does.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #scripture
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
